blackhost/.README.md: Minimal human-facing overview for installing and discovering the blackhost skill.
blackhost/.CHANGELOG.md: Versioned one-line release log with Version, User, LLM, and 240-character summary entries.
blackhost/.LICENSE.md: PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0 with the required Blackaft Associates notice.

local/..venv/: Generated blackhost-managed Python virtualenv for local YAML-backed tooling such as skill validation.
local/.index-server.log: Generated local status HTTP server log for system-browser index.html review.
local/.index-server.pid: Generated local status HTTP server PID used to reuse the browser review server.
local/.index.json: Local generated status cache with latest observed host tooling, command result, and terminal output.
local/.index.html: Local generated static Bootstrap status view rendered from the latest blackhost command result, including raw assurance/log.txt output at the bottom.

assurance/.dry.sh: Dry-run assurance runner for commands that preview host or workspace mutation.
assurance/.eval.sh: Top-level assurance runner for static validation, route smoke tests, dry-run checks, stale-path checks, and log generation.
assurance/.log.txt: Overwritten assurance log from the latest dry.sh or eval.sh run.

manifests/.aws.json: AWS CLI package modules, SSO browser authentication, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.core.json: Core router, host detection, helper modules, root commands, routing grammar, and shared shell dependencies.
manifests/.docker.json: Docker package modules, app scaffolding, local app runs, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.homebrew.json: Homebrew package-manager modules, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.git.json: Git package modules, commands, options, supported hosts, repository context, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.gh.json: GitHub CLI package modules, browser authentication, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.gcloud.json: Google Cloud CLI package modules, browser authentication, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.php.json: PHP package modules, Composer integration, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.node.json: Node.js package modules, npm/npx integration, local app runs, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.python.json: Python package modules, pip integration, local static server runs, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.
manifests/.yaml.json: YAML package modules, PyYAML integration, commands, options, supported hosts, and mutation boundaries.

aws/.auth.sh: AWS CLI SSO browser authentication command that guides user validation and checks final identity status.
aws/.check.sh: AWS CLI readiness command that checks CLI availability and caller identity resolution.
aws/.install.sh: AWS CLI v2 installation command for supported macOS and Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
aws/.commons.sh: AWS CLI common helpers for CLI availability, version output, caller identity checks, and identity diagnostics.
aws/.update.sh: AWS CLI v2 update command with prompts and dry-run support.

core/.helpers/: Shared shell helpers for path resolution, OS detection, convention-based package routing, terminal messaging, prompts, dry-run command execution, JSON result output, local index rendering, and temporary file cleanup.
core/.init.sh: Root blackhost CLI entrypoint that bootstraps the shared runtime and routes discovered package commands.

docker/.check.sh: Docker readiness command that checks CLI availability, daemon reachability, Compose, Buildx, runtime smoke, and disk usage.
docker/.dockerise.sh: Docker scaffold command that writes Docker deployment files into a target app directory with prompts, dry-run support, and overwrite protection.
docker/.install.sh: Docker installation command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
docker/.commons.sh: Docker common helpers for CLI availability, daemon reachability, Compose, Buildx, host guidance, and daemon waiting.
docker/.run.sh: Docker local app run command that builds, starts, maps, and optionally opens a Dockerised target app.
docker/.update.sh: Docker update command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts, dry-run support, diagnostics, and optional cleanup.

git/.check.sh: Git readiness command that checks Git CLI availability and optional repository/global identity details.
git/.install.sh: Git installation command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
git/.commons.sh: Git common helpers for CLI availability, version output, repository context, and global identity checks.
git/.update.sh: Git update command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.

gh/.auth.sh: GitHub CLI browser authentication command that guides user validation and checks final auth status.
gh/.check.sh: GitHub CLI readiness command that checks gh availability and authentication status.
gh/.install.sh: GitHub CLI installation command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
gh/.commons.sh: GitHub CLI common helpers for CLI availability, version output, and auth status checks.
gh/.update.sh: GitHub CLI update command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.

gcloud/.auth.sh: Google Cloud CLI browser authentication command that guides user validation and checks final active account status.
gcloud/.check.sh: Google Cloud CLI readiness command that checks CLI availability and active authentication status.
gcloud/.install.sh: Google Cloud CLI installation command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
gcloud/.commons.sh: Google Cloud CLI common helpers for CLI availability, version output, active account checks, and config diagnostics.
gcloud/.update.sh: Google Cloud CLI update command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.

homebrew/.check.sh: Homebrew readiness command that checks package-manager availability and optional diagnostics.
homebrew/.install.sh: Homebrew installation command for supported macOS and Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
homebrew/.commons.sh: Homebrew common helpers for CLI availability, version output, and prefix diagnostics.
homebrew/.update.sh: Homebrew update command that runs brew update and brew upgrade with prompts and dry-run support.

php/.check.sh: PHP readiness command that checks PHP CLI, Composer, common extensions, inline runtime execution, and optional configuration details.
php/.install.sh: PHP and Composer installation command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
php/.commons.sh: PHP and Composer common helpers for CLI availability, versions, PHP ini, and extension checks.
php/.run.sh: PHP local app run command that starts a background PHP development server and optionally opens it in a browser.
php/.update.sh: PHP and Composer update command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts, dry-run support, and diagnostics.

python/.check.sh: Python readiness command that checks Python 3, pip, standard modules, inline runtime execution, and optional configuration details.
python/.install.sh: Python and pip installation command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
python/.commons.sh: Python and pip common helpers for CLI availability, pip, venv, executable details, and module checks.
python/.run.sh: Python local static app run command that starts a background http.server process and optionally opens it in a browser.
python/.update.sh: Python and pip update command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts, dry-run support, and diagnostics.

yaml/.check.sh: YAML readiness command that checks python3, pip, and PyYAML import availability.
yaml/.install.sh: PyYAML installation command for the blackhost-managed virtualenv with prompts and dry-run support.
yaml/.commons.sh: YAML common helpers for python3, pip, and PyYAML availability and version checks.
yaml/.run.sh: YAML parse command that validates a YAML file through PyYAML.
yaml/.update.sh: PyYAML update command for the blackhost-managed virtualenv with prompts and dry-run support.

node/.check.sh: Node.js readiness command that checks Node.js, npm, npx, inline runtime execution, and optional npm configuration details.
node/.install.sh: Node.js, npm, and npx installation command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts and dry-run support.
node/.commons.sh: Node.js common helpers for CLI availability, versions, package script detection, and package script validation.
node/.run.sh: Node.js local app run command that starts a background npm package script process and optionally opens it in a browser.
node/.update.sh: Node.js, npm, and npx update command for supported macOS and Debian-like Linux hosts with prompts, dry-run support, and diagnostics.

templates/..gitignore: Reusable generated-state ignore template for blackhost local index, HTML status, and assurance log artifacts.
templates/.index.json: Reusable local status index template for generated per-user blackhost state.
templates/.manifest.json: Reusable package manifest template with the canonical top-level manifest structure.

scripts/.auth.sh: Reusable package browser-authentication command template with prompts and dry-run support.
scripts/.install.sh: Reusable package installation command template with prompts and dry-run support.
scripts/.run.sh: Reusable package run command template with prompts and dry-run support.
scripts/.update.sh: Reusable package update command template with prompts and dry-run support.

schemas/.eval.json: Deterministic checks and principles for using and updating the blackhost skill.
schemas/.maintain.json: Deterministic maintenance process for package, routing, schema, and assurance changes.
schemas/.skill.openapi.yml: OpenAPI 3.1 style projection of the public blackhost command surface.
